algorithms.notes: Independent DGL CUDA implementation of the same Auer-Bisseling greedy matching publication used by PyTorch Cluster. Pair/singleton cluster IDs require output conversion.
CUDA randomized red/blue greedy matching from the paper cited by upstream. Cluster IDs encode matched pairs or singletons; select the weighted mode and reconstruct pair endpoints.

Original 2015 source is available upon request according to the author page; no request was sent. A public PDF was not located. BootCMatchG supplies a separate publicly available implementation and is cataloged separately.
The kernel is reusable but the executable solves AMG systems. A standalone graph adapter must supply original graph weights and expose the matching, rather than AMG-generated weights.
Public source was not located in the author/publication searches. The author PDF request also failed; retain the verified publication link.

Symmetric loop-free graph and nonnegative edge weights; the routine is approximate, not an exact maximum-weight matching solver. No associated GPU research paper was verified for this specific implementation; documentation is retained as documentation.
